row.evidence: Paychex packages (Basic, Foundations, Advanced, Complete) are all "Request Pricing" and no package, help page or API reference mentions SCIM or SAML SSO; every Paychex app in the Okta catalogue is SWA-only.
row.notes: New row. Scored on Paychex Flex (main admin product). No SCIM and no SAML/OIDC SSO documented on any public Paychex page (compare page, sitemap, llms.txt, developer portal OpenAPI spec, Paychex Marketplace). All six Paychex apps in Okta's catalogue are SWA password-vaulting; no Entra gallery tutorial. Paychex is the HR system of record: the developer API (OAuth2 client credentials, apps created by a Flex Super/Security Admin) manages worker records, not Flex user logins. All packages are quote-only. Confidence low: the Paychex Flex help centre sits behind the client login, so the absence search is incomplete (same treatment as the ADP row).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented on paychex.com, the developer portal API spec or the Paychex Marketplace; every Okta catalogue app for Paychex is SWA (password vaulting). Left null rather than false because Paychex never says no; status none by absence. Paychex is the HR/payroll system of record (rule 3b).

webhooks_user_events.notes: Worker (employee record) webhook domains, not Paychex Flex login events.

limitations.text: API manages worker (employee/contractor) HR records; workers added via API start IN_PROGRESS and must be completed in Paychex Flex; only in-progress workers can be deleted. No endpoints for Paychex Flex user logins, roles or security groups.

user_api.notes: Clients create an app inside Paychex Flex (Super Admin or Security Admin role needed); OAuth2 client_credentials. Which Paychex packages include API access is not stated.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks only SWA. Search for "paychex" returns six apps (Paychex, MyPaychex Self Service Portal, Paychex Online, Paychex Benefits, Paychex BeneTrac eenroller, PayChex Time and Labor Online), all tagged SWA.

entra.notes: No Paychex entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index (learn.microsoft.com toc.json).

fallbacks.other_sync: Paychex is an HR/payroll system of record; the Paychex Flex worker API and worker webhooks let other systems read and update employee records.
